initiative.description: Deliver the ForgeLLM-IRC customer journey MVP from webhook intake through IRC swarm collaboration and captured RCA-ready outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: P1 workflow is operational end-to-end for at least one tenant.
Core workflows are measurable with operational telemetry.
Security and governance baseline controls are enforced.

epics.name: Intake & Trace Translation
epics.summary: Build secure webhook intake and trace translation pipeline

stories.summary: Define and implement webhook ingest contract
tasks: Create signed ingest payload schema with validation rules
Add ingest rejection telemetry for malformed payloads
Normalize trace envelope fields for frontend/backend/version/region
Persist translation envelope with bounded retention

stories.summary: Harden ingest reliability and replay safety

epics.name: IRC Swarm Orchestration (Bot + Rovo)
epics.summary: Orchestrate bot callbacks and Rovo triage workflows in incident channels

tasks: Queue Jira-grounded ask actions from Forge
Bind issue context fetch with permission-safe asApp calls
Persist queue/audit envelopes for action traceability

epics.name: Capture & Knowledge Output
epics.summary: Capture swarm output into RCA/timeline artifacts with publish targets

tasks: Create job envelope schema for channel distillation
Publish draft output to Jira or Confluence target
Link generated artifact to incident issue context

epics.name: Security & Governance Baseline
epics.summary: Ship minimum governance controls for incident-safe operation

stories.summary: Implement admin policy and RBAC controls
tasks: Gate sensitive config paths to admins

epics.name: Observability & Ops Readiness
epics.summary: Establish telemetry, SLO checks, and runbooks for production operations

tasks: Add correlation identifiers across workflow stages
Define retry paths for callback failures
